Available for PlayStation™ VR2 from November 19th, 2026.

Join the Winx and Epic Roller Coasters on a magical adventure!

After a surprise attack on Alfea by the Army of Darkness and the Trix, Bloom heads to Cloud Tower to rescue the captured Winx. Will the wielder of the Dragon Flame be able to save her friends?

The "Epic Roller Coasters: Winx Club™" DLC bundle consists of three themed roller coasters, one magic scepter for blaster mode, and two magical carts.

Get this new DLC bundle for $14.99.

This DLC can be played in Classic, Shooter, and Racing modes, in single player and multiplayer mode.

Download the Epic Roller Coasters base game for VR2 for free from the PlayStation Store.
